# Bank onboarding: compliance and scope

| Ref | Obligation |
|---|---|
| C1 | Customer identity documents must be verified against an official register, per the Anti-Money-Laundering Rules. |
| C2 | Accounts must not be opened for anyone under 18, under the Banking Code 3. |

## Backlog

US-1 As a compliance officer, I want to see a list of pending applications so that I can work through them.
US-2 As a compliance officer, I want applicants under 18 to be declined automatically so that no minor opens an account.
US-3 As a new customer, I want my application checked properly so that the bank can trust who I am.
US-4 As a new customer, I want to upload a photo of my passport so that I can open an account.
constraints: Customer identity documents must be verified against an official register, per the Anti-Money-Laundering Rules.
Accounts must not be opened for anyone under 18, under the Banking Code 3.
